claims.statement: Server-to-agent log client forwards task/follow/tail and optional bearer token using request context.
limitations: Configured bootstrap token path differs from node enrollment credential; stream authorization has its own boundary.

claims.statement: Engine uses StdCopy and scanners with stream tags/read-time timestamps; agent prints text without those fields.
limitations: Concurrent stdout/stderr scanning does not establish application-global ordering; default scanner bounds apply.

claims.statement: Worker malformed tail falls back to all while follow remains independently controlled.
limitations: Parsed negative integer follows downstream path; public CLI exposes a narrower subset than Runtime LogOptions.

limitations: Does not prove every real blocked Engine reader/pipe/scanner exits on disconnect.
